summary: Student Pay Information module handles the management of student salary details including union membership and bank account information. It supports data binding for display and update functions and enforces specific validation rules, mainly for the annual increment date.
purpose: Manage and display student salary information within the system, including union membership details and bank account info.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the pay information entry.

fields.name: StudentID
fields.description: Identifier for the student associated with the pay information.

fields.name: AnnualIncrementDate
fields.description: Date for annual salary increment, formatted to exclude specific year considerations.

fields.name: UnionMembershipCodeID
fields.description: Code identifier for union membership associated with the student.

fields.name: UnionMembershipDescription
fields.description: Description of the union membership, with support for alternate language fields.

fields.name: BankAccountName
fields.description: Name of the bank account for salary deposits.

fields.name: AccountNumber
fields.description: Account number for salary deposit transactions.

actors.name: UserSession
actors.description: Manages user session information for accessing student pay details.

workflows.name: Updating Student Pay Information
steps: User initiates update through the interface.
System checks for annual increment date validity.
Union membership information is updated via dropdown selection.
Changes are saved, and the user is redirected to the Payroll page.

workflows.name: Inserting New Pay Information
steps: System checks if record exists; if not, switches to Insert Mode.
User provides necessary details including annual increment date and bank information.
System validates increment date and adds pay information to database.

business_rules.name: Valid Increment Date Rule
business_rules.description: Annual increment date should not be February 29th; checks enforced to prevent leap year entries.

validations.name: Increment Date Validation
validations.description: Ensures annual increment date is valid and not a leap day; prevents saving invalid dates.

system_behavior.name: Session Check
system_behavior.description: Cancels data retrieval if user session is not active.
